name: qrlink
description: A QR-code that can change where it points to

scripts.qrlink: npm run qrlink:build && npm run qrlink:start
scripts.qrlink:start: cd NextJS && npm run start && cd ..
scripts.qrlink:dev: cd NextJS && npm run dev && cd ..
scripts.qrlink:build: cd NextJS && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.install: cd NextJS && npm install && npx next-ws-cli@latest patch --yes && cd ..
